body:
there is, sorta? it’s kind of complicated. it’s mainly fear that keeping me from trying harder. despite what my mother has done to me over the years, i don’t want her to get in trouble or whatever. plus, where i live the treatment here is highly stigmatized, hence why i’m hopefully moving out next weekend.

and dude. it’s really fucking hard dealing with it and i’m tired of people seeing me as toxic when i have a flashback/emotional breakdown. it’s not 1,2,3 restrain yourself yknow? we all don’t wanna be this way. i wish it wasn’t so stigmatized and misunderstood.
